findings.help: Use `Account<'info, T>`, which checks the owner and discriminator, or add `require_keys_eq!(*account.owner, crate::ID)` before reading.
findings.message: Account data is deserialised without verifying the account owner. An attacker can pass a look-alike account owned by another program.
findings.title: missing owner check

findings.help: Add `[profile.release]` with `overflow-checks = true` to the workspace manifest. Overflow then aborts the transaction instead of writing a wrapped value.
findings.message: This workspace does not set `overflow-checks = true` under `[profile.release]`. Solana programs are built in release mode, so arithmetic that overflows wraps silently instead of aborting the transaction.
findings.title: overflow-checks is not enabled

findings.help: Enable `overflow-checks` for the release profile, or use `checked_add` / `checked_sub` / `checked_mul` and handle the `None` case.
findings.message: Unchecked addition writes into a struct field, and this workspace does not enable `overflow-checks`, so an overflow wraps silently instead of aborting the transaction.
findings.title: unchecked arithmetic
